CentraFlow 1.9.0 (build 19)

Optional Android 11+ conversation bubbles. Open Menu > Settings > Message notifications, enable message notifications, then enable Conversation bubbles. Open Android bubble settings to allow selected or all conversations. For selected conversations, tap the bubble icon on a supported message notification.

A floating conversation reuses the existing chat screen for reading, photos, replies and reactions. Android controls bubble appearance and availability. Generic conversation/app icons are used. Normal alerts remain available when bubbles are unsupported, disabled or unavailable; notification Reply/Retry is retained. Turning off message notifications or signing out disables bubbles. Bubbles are off by default.

Nineteen focused Flutter checks passed. Physical bubble expansion, keyboard/window sizing, background delivery, dismissal and opt-out behavior still need phone acceptance. Android settings, DND and OEM limits can suppress or delay alerts. This remains a two-account test rollout, not an exact Meta Messenger clone. No planner schema, backend, billing, account or data reset changes.

Install over the existing app via Settings > App updates; Android asks for confirmation. Do not uninstall or clear data.
